answer: Self‑attention requires only a constant number of sequential operations ( O(1) ) and its longest information‑propagation path between any two positions is also constant ( O(1) ), whereas a recurrent layer needs a linear number of sequential steps ( O(n) ) and its maximum path length grows linearly with the sequence length ( O(n) )[Attention Is All You Need, arXiv:1706.03762v7, PDF p. 6].
question: How do self-attention and recurrent layers compare in sequential operations and maximum path length, according to Table 1?
